svg.title: Keep the big stretches, throw the rest away
svg.desc: A whiteboard sketch showing a dashed unit circle deformed into a tilted ellipse with the two eigenvector directions drawn as bold red arrows labelled with stretch factors of 3.1 and 0.6; the singular value decomposition drawn as a chain of four shapes - circle, rotated circle, stretched ellipse and rotated ellipse - with the arrows between them labelled V transpose, sigma and U and the semi-axes marked sigma one and sigma two; a strip of one photograph rebuilt at ranks 1, 5, 20 and 50 with the fraction of energy kept written under each and rank 20 picked out as 98.1 percent of the matrix for 12.8 times fewer numbers; a scree plot with the elbow marked; and the LoRA picture of a frozen 4096-by-4096 weight matrix beside two thin adapters holding 131,072 parameters instead of 16,777,216.
svg.text: Keep the big stretches, throw the rest away
every other arrow gets turned. These two
the σ's are the only place the SIZE of the matrix lives
one 427x640 photo, rebuilt from the top k singular values
98.1% of the matrix for 12.8x fewer numbers. PSNR 20.9 dB
the SAME trick, applied to a weight matrix
same idea as rank 20 on the photo
